column2: run inside its container by `python -m eval_kg measure-deps`.

column1: # A check fails when the service or anything it really depends on is down; the disruption runner stops one
# host at a time and records which other hosts' checks fail (the observed dependents).
# service = docker compose service name; command runs with `sh -c` and must exit 0 when healthy.
